question: On what basis does the 2020 ACC/AHA valvular heart disease guideline assign disease stages A to D?
B: Symptoms, valve anatomy, severity of valve dysfunction and response of the ventricle and pulmonary circulation
D: Hospital volume of the treating centre
explanation: Staging combines symptoms, anatomy, severity of dysfunction and the ventricular and pulmonary circulation response.
